languageParity: HR and EN notices carry the same substance.

hr: Javni portal prikazuje samo javne informacije i operativne sažetke koje pripremaju odgovorni workeri i deskovi.
Newsroom workeri provjeravaju vijesti prema allowlisti izvora i objavljuju ih u kontroliranim dnevnim terminima, najmanje 3x dnevno i ciljano 10+ objava dnevno.
Finance Signal Worker smije objavljivati javne operativne finance/KPI signale, ali ne knjigovodstvena izvješća ni službene financijske izvještaje.
Pravne, osobne i službene financijske tvrdnje idu na ručni pregled prije javne objave.
Mail Studio, admin i operator funkcije nalaze se iza zaštićenog pristupa. Nema masovnog slanja i nema kampanja.
en: The public portal displays only public information and operating summaries prepared by responsible workers and desks.
Newsroom workers check news against the source allowlist and publish it in controlled daily windows, at least 3x daily and targeting 10+ posts per day.
Finance Signal Worker may publish public operating finance/KPI signals, but not accounting reports or official financial statements.
Legal, personal-data and official financial claims go to manual review before public publication.
Mail Studio, admin and operator functions remain behind protected access. No mass sending and no campaigns.

hr: Media korisnik sam kreira korisničko ime i lozinku te nije admin korisnik.
Prijava se može spremiti kao nacrt i kasnije nastaviti.
Slanje prijave ne znači automatsko odobrenje. Status pregledava Media Intake Worker i operator za medije.
Komunikacija je individualna; nema kampanja i nema masovnog slanja.
en: The media user creates their own username and password and is not an admin user.
The application can be saved as a draft and continued later.
Submitting an application does not mean automatic approval. The status is reviewed by the Media Intake Worker and media operator.
Communication is individual; no campaigns and no mass sending.

hr: Financijski prikaz je javni informativni sloj, a ne privatna knjigovodstvena evidencija.
Finance Signal Worker može pripremati javne KPI signale, projekcije i operativne komentare.
Službeni financijski izvještaji, privatni dokumenti, osobni podaci i interna evidencija nisu dio javne stranice.
Simulacije trgovanja su samo paper trading i ne koriste stvarni novac.
en: The finance view is a public information layer, not a private accounting record.
Finance Signal Worker may prepare public KPI signals, projections and operating comments.
Official financial statements, private documents, personal data and internal records are not part of the public page.
Trading simulations are paper trading only and do not use real money.
